test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 26 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Rearrange the following sentence parts to form a meaningful and grammatically correct paragraph:

P. She presented the findings to her team, revealing new patterns in the business.

Q. She created a series of functions to clean and transform the data, making it usable.

R. She developed a dashboard to visualise the insights and trends hidden in the data.

S. She wrote a script to extract raw data from multiple sources
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sequence begins with **Sentence S**, as it introduces the initial step of extracting raw data from multiple sources:
 
 
• "She wrote a script to extract raw data from multiple sources."
 
 
 
• **Sentence Q** follows, describing how the raw data was processed and transformed to make it usable:
 
 
• "She created a series of functions to clean and transform the data, making it usable."
 
 
 
• **Sentence R** is next, as it logically explains the creation of a dashboard to visualize the insights derived from the cleaned data:
 
 
• "She developed a dashboard to visualise the insights and trends hidden in the data."
 
 
 
• **Sentence P** concludes the paragraph by describing how the findings were presented to her team:
 
 
• "She presented the findings to her team, revealing new patterns in the business."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **S, Q, R, P**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"She wrote a script to extract raw data from multiple sources. She created a series of functions to clean and transform the data, making it usable. She developed a dashboard to visualise the insights and trends hidden in the data. She presented the findings to her team, revealing new patterns in the business."</div
